name: Obsessive Allure
body:
Price 3,000 gp; Slot —; CL 8th; Weight —; Aura moderate enchantment

DESCRIPTION

This functions as honeyed allure (DC 16 Will negates). In addition, the wearer or wielder of the object becomes paranoid about losing the item and afraid of it being damaged or stolen. He takes elaborate precautions to safeguard it and is extremely suspicious of anyone commenting on his odd behavior or his precious item, responding to them as if targeted with malicious spite (DC 16 Will negates).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,500 gp; Spells beguiling gift, bestow curse, malicious spite
